extracted.name: Real Hungarian Goulash (No Tomato Paste Here)
extracted.description: Enjoy this authentic Hungarian goulash recipe, made with beef, onions, and Hungarian paprika, with a slice of rustic bread.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Melt lard in a large pot over medium heat. Cook and stir onions in hot lard until soft and translucent, 5 to 8 minutes.

Stir beef and paprika into onions. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Add 1 cup water and simmer, adding more water if moisture gets too low, until meat falls apart and onion sauce is thick, about 1 hour more. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
